SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_equipment_info e JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(e.equip_nm, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.equip_kind, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.pur_cust, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(e.mak_cust, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR e.equip_sys_cd LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR e.equip_cd LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND e.use_at = 'Y'
AND e.use_at = 'N'

SELECT e.equipment_id AS equipmentId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, e.equip_sys_cd AS equipSysCd, e.equip_cd AS equipCd, e.equip_nm AS equipNm, e.equip_kind AS equipKind, e.pur_date AS purDate, e.pur_cust AS purCust, e.mak_cust AS makCust, e.equip_spec AS equipSpec, e.location AS location, e.bigo AS bigo, CASE WHEN e.use_at = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active FROM tb_equipment_info e JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND e.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
